The '''Fifteenth Legislative Assembly of Haryana''' constituted after the [[2024 Haryana Legislative Assembly election|2024 Haryana Legislative Assembly elections]]. Legislative Assembly [[election]] was held in [[Haryana]] on 5 October 2024 to elect 90 members of the [[Haryana Legislative Assembly]].<ref>{{cite news |date=31 August 2024 |title=Haryana Poll Date Moved To October 5; J&K and Haryana Results Now On October 8 |url=https://www.timesnownews.com/india/haryana-poll-date-moved-to-october-5-jk-and-haryana-results-now-set-for-october-8-article-112952021 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240831134119/https://www.timesnownews.com/india/haryana-poll-date-moved-to-october-5-jk-and-haryana-results-now-set-for-october-8-article-112952021 |archive-date=31 August 2024 |access-date=31 August 2024 |work=[[Times Now]]}}</ref> The results were announced on 8 October 2024.<ref>{{cite news |date=31 August 2024 |title=Haryana Assembly Election: EC Revises Polling Date To October 5, Counting On October 8 |url=https://www.thedailyjagran.com/india/haryana-assembly-election-date-revised-ec-shifts-polling-date-to-october-5-counting-on-october8-10184539 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240831134119/https://english.jagran.com/india/haryana-assembly-election-date-revised-ec-shifts-polling-date-to-october-5-counting-on-october8-10184539 |archive-date=31 August 2024 |access-date=31 August 2024 |work=[[Jagran Prakashan|English Jagran]]}}</ref>
